name: Magram Alliance
summary: In Desolace, Gurda Wildmane urges you to turn the centaur clans' hatred against them. Befriend one clan to learn how all can be beaten. If you side with the Magram, slay the Gelkis, then speak with Warug at the edge of Magram Village in southeast Desolace.

sections.title: Hatred as a Weapon
sections.body: Gurda Wildmane urges you to turn the centaur clans' hatred against them. Choose one clan as an ally and learn from it how all can be beaten. If you side with the Magram, slaying their foes, the Gelkis, earns their respect.

sections.title: The Spokesman
sections.body: Warug, the Magram spokesman, waits on the outskirts of Magram Village in southeast Desolace once you have earned enough respect. Before then, he has nothing to say to you. The Magram have no words for the weak. They kill them instead. To prove your strength, Warug sends you to face many Gelkis.

sections.title: Warug's Judgment
sections.body: Warug says the Gelkis weep at the sound of your name. They fear and hate you as they do the Magram. Perhaps, he allows, you are as strong as the Magram. He will judge for himself.

faq.q: Who proposes an alliance with the Magram?
faq.answer: Gurda Wildmane urges you to turn the centaur clans' hatred against them. Side with one clan and learn how all can be beaten.

faq.q: How do you earn the respect of the Magram?
aliases: how to get friendly with magram
faq.answer: Slay the Gelkis, the Magram's foes, to earn their respect.
Warug, the Magram spokesman, waits on the outskirts of Magram Village in southeast Desolace.

faq.q: Why does Warug refuse to speak at first?
faq.answer: Warug says the Magram have no words for the weak and kill them instead. Prove your strength by slaying many Gelkis.
